values.meaning: Bonus attack damage while on the hunt
Hunt duration (also the movement speed buff duration)
values.quote: {{tt|5 seconds|Hunt begins from the start of the cast time}}

values.meaning: Number of additional Packmates summoned partway through the hunt
Time into the hunt before the additional Packmates are summoned
values.binNote: No bin row for this timing exists in the sheet; the sheet's NaafiriR fields cover duration, packmate count, MS, and AD but not this internal delay, so it is likely tooltip/animation-only data not exposed under this slot's listed rows.

mechanics.claim: Naafiri can move during this ability's cast time.
mechanics.quote: '''Naafiri''' can move during The Call of the Pack's cast time.

mechanics.claim: For the first 1 second of the hunt Naafiri is untargetable and ghosted, and for the first 0.9 seconds her active Packmates vanish and later reappear near her.
mechanics.quote: becoming {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|ghosted}} for the first 1 second and {{tip|vanish|vanishing}} all of her active ''{{ai|We Are More|Naafiri|Packmates}}'' in the first {{fd|0.9}} seconds

mechanics.claim: Casting Hounds' Pursuit (R) while The Call of the Pack is active extends the hunt duration by 1.75 seconds, up to the original duration.
mechanics.quote: Casting {{ai|Hounds' Pursuit|Naafiri}} extends The Call of the Pack's hunt duration by {{fd|1.75}} seconds, up to its original duration.

mechanics.claim: Ability effects (untargetability, AD/MS buffs, extra Packmates) apply at the end of the cast time.
